commit.message:
fix: resolve DTS build failure and cookie config test

Add `as unknown as ReturnType<typeof betterAuth>` assertion to the `auth` export in auth.definition.ts. Without it, tsup's DTS emitter tries to reference `better-auth/dist/plugins/anonymous/types.mjs`, an unexported internal subpath, causing TS2742. This was blocking the pre-push hook for all contributors.

Update the cookie-config test to match the actual code: cookies use `secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'` (not a literal `true`) so local development over HTTP works. The test now guards against `secure: false` being hardcoded.
